seoTitle: Browser Video Converter: Re-encode to WebM or MP4
metaDescription: Convert a video to WebM or MP4 using only your browser. No ffmpeg download, no upload. Honest limits explained: real-time recording, no MOV output.
intro: Re-encodes a video to WebM, or to MP4 where your browser can record it, using the built-in media recorder instead of ffmpeg.
why:
Many converters load a large ffmpeg build or upload your file. This tool uses what the browser already has: it plays your video and records it again with MediaRecorder. That keeps the page tiny and your file private.

The trade-offs are real. It records in real time, so a 60 second clip takes about a minute and the tab must stay visible. MOV and other containers cannot be written by the browser, and MP4 recording depends on your browser version. Use it when you need a quick WebM or MP4 for the web, not for professional transcoding.
